payload.title: Calculating Global Coherence as a function of Glacial/Interglacial cycles
payload.description: This notebook uses the Pyleoclim library to calculate global coherence between insolation and oxygen isotopes across glacial and interglacial cycles. It defines functions to handle records with large hiatuses, creates insolation curves using Climlab, and sets boundaries for glacial/interglacial periods based on LR04 data. The notebook analyzes data from the Sanbao cave, Buckeye Creek, and a marine sediment core from the Bay of Bengal, breaking them into glacial and interglacial components to assess coherence.
